item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Car seat caution: Some vehicles fit child seats much better than others
item.description: Cars.com tested 56 vehicles for car seat fit and ease of use. Only two earned top marks across the board.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Man accused of kidnapping, killing Jennifer Odom in 1993 heads to trial
item.description: A man linked to a decades-old cold case through DNA evidence goes on trial Monday for the 1993 abduction and murder of 12-year-old Jennifer Odom.
